_comment: MECHA-FORGE asset roster for Meshy v6. Each asset -> textured GLB -> (if rig) Meshy auto-rig + animations -> bake_anim.py spritesheets, else bake_meshy.py static sprite + procedural 2D motion. Meshy auto-rig is humanoid-biped only, so non-humanoids (flying/6-leg/wheeled/quad) get proc='...' animated in-engine. action ids: idle 0, walk 106, attack 4, hit 178, die 8.
